title: Exact replay of the GLiNER assertion anchor failure
question: Where did the negative token span in the full-book candidate run originate?
method: Rebuild the exact retained context, replay the pinned model with a matched definition control, trace the natural anchor and enum formatter, and restrict the anchor query in a process-local counterfactual.

inputs.role: Read-only retained-context reconstruction and local inference probe

outputs.role: Exact decoder coordinates and replay controls

conclusion: The exact assertion request seeds a literal predicate record from a categorical schema-prefix token. The enum formatter projects that token through the source-only map and reproduces the native error. Restricting seed candidates to source positions removes the exception for the reproduced input.
